finding: Two body cases are missing. (1) A body that json.loads cannot decode as text (for example invalid UTF-8) raises an error that is not JSONDecodeError, so FastAPI returns 400 {"detail":"There was an error parsing the body"}. Go's encoding/json accepts invalid UTF-8, so the handler must check for it. (2) FastAPI parses the body before the app-wide 0-RTT dependency runs, so a JSON decode error gives 422 even with Early-Data: 1. Only a body that parses, valid or not, gets the 425. Body parsing must happen before the 0-RTT check, or the 0-RTT middleware must let the 422 and 400 cases go first.
